capture.method: Fresh native actors in per-case isolated research subagent sessions (19 sessions, one per case, batches of at most 5) read only their exported public prompt, policies, and response contract. No expected answers, prior responses, or tests supplied. Responses imported unchanged as JSON values. A separate isolated research subagent reviewer checked prompts against policies and responses without reading scenarios.json or run_evals.py.
capture.limitations: Per-case isolated sessions rather than one shared actor context; actual scenario operations NOT_OBSERVED; provider model ID and usage UNMEASURED. Policy regression only, not a performance comparison. One in-flight batch-3 actor (scope-delta) was interrupted by a server restart and run in a fresh isolated session with batch 4.
